description: Two young men in yellow high-visibility vests and work boots lift a large flat-screen television down from the back of a white delivery van on a city street. As they carry it, a woman in a short brown dress and heels walks past on the pavement. Both men turn their heads to follow her, still holding the heavy screen between them, and one nearly loses his grip. They set the television down and stand with their hands on their hips, watching her walk away.

taps.phrase: to stand with hands on hips
